description: This PHP source file defines a web page for configuring and controlling voice diagnostic debug settings related to SIP logs, including server IP and port, and line gain settings for a VoIP service provider. It includes HTML, embedded PHP, JavaScript, and functions for retrieving and updating configuration data.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Function that retrieves current VoIP debug configuration data such as ingress gain, egress gain, SIP log server IP and port, and SIP process status from device configuration.
